sloka: त्यज्य काम वृत्तत्वम् शोकम् सम् न्यस्य पृष्टतः ।महात्मानम् कृतात्मानम् आत्मानम् न अवबुध्यसे ॥४-१-१२३॥
transliteration: tyajya kāma vṛttatvam śokam sam nyasya pṛṣṭataḥ ।mahātmānam kṛtātmānam ātmānam na avabudhyase ॥4-1-123॥

translations.english: 'Bardon grief. Give up emotion. You are a great soul. You are not aware of your great accomplishments. (The temporary sorrow has relegated Rama's nobility to the background. Lakshmana is trying to restore the same)'.
